style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#B9C2CA;fontColor=#16212B;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;" value="<b>How to read this</b><br>1 The owner signs in with Firebase Authentication; a new user first creates a workspace (free trial).<br>2 The SPA sends any file to kredibel-web with a verified ID token. An exact copy (same SHA-256) is recorded and never read; anything else is stored and split into pages.<br>3 kredibel-web enqueues one Cloud Task per document on kredibel-documents, named doc-{docId}-n, so a retry cannot read a file twice.<br>4 Cloud Tasks pushes the task to kredibel-worker with an OIDC token; only that service account may invoke it.<br>5 The document workflow has Gemini read every page image (5a); the PDF text layer, or Document AI OCR for scans and photos (5b), is the independent witness. Code verifies, checks for duplicates and forensics.<br>6 Each month the document touches gets a task on kredibel-months; only the latest generation writes, so the upload order never changes the result.<br>7 The month workflow reconciles, scores fraud risk, explains it with Gemini and writes matches, review items and the money flow to Firestore.<br>8 The browser listens read-only and fetches data through the API. Not drawn: all writes go through the API; logs carry IDs only, never document text." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="1240" x="300" y="750" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
How to read this
1 The owner signs in with Firebase Authentication; a new user first creates a workspace (free trial).
2 The SPA sends any file to kredibel-web with a verified ID token. An exact copy (same SHA-256) is recorded and never read; anything else is stored and split into pages.
3 kredibel-web enqueues one Cloud Task per document on kredibel-documents, named doc-{docId}-n, so a retry cannot read a file twice.
4 Cloud Tasks pushes the task to kredibel-worker with an OIDC token; only that service account may invoke it.
5 The document workflow has Gemini read every page image (5a); the PDF text layer, or Document AI OCR for scans and photos (5b), is the independent witness. Code verifies, checks for duplicates and forensics.
6 Each month the document touches gets a task on kredibel-months; only the latest generation writes, so the upload order never changes the result.
7 The month workflow reconciles, scores fraud risk, explains it with Gemini and writes matches, review items and the money flow to Firestore.
8 The browser listens read-only and fetches data through the API. Not drawn: all writes go through the API; logs carry IDs only, never document text.
